list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Mononuclear Tm(III) complex with two chelating DME ligands, three terminal pentafluorobenzenethiolates, and a weak intramolecular Tm–F interaction of 2.842(3) Å, giving eight-coordinate Tm.

synthesis.procedure: Under ultrapure nitrogen, Tm metal and mercury pentafluorobenzenethiolate were combined in DME and stirred overnight until the metal dissolved and elemental mercury appeared. The solution was decanted from mercury, filtered, concentrated under vacuum, and layered with hexane.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Dry-box or Schlenk technique under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Decanted from mercury, filtered, concentrated from 30 mL to approximately 15 mL, then layered with 15 mL hexane to obtain pale-yellow crystals.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete, nearly linear array of four Tm(III) ions linked successively by three, two, and three bridging benzenethiolates. Each Tm binds one chelating DME ligand; the two outer Tm ions additionally bind two terminal benzenethiolates each. All four Tm centers are seven-coordinate.

synthesis.procedure: Under ultrapure nitrogen, Tm metal and diphenyl disulfide were combined in DME with catalytic mercury and stirred for five days until the metal dissolved. The solution was filtered, concentrated under vacuum, and layered with hexane; crystals appeared after one week.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Dry-box or Schlenk technique under ultrapure nitrogen
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered from a trace black precipitate, concentrated from 40 mL to approximately 15 mL, and layered with 15 mL hexane to give light-yellow block crystals.
